facts.claim: 开篇用圣诞老人买雪橇的笑话做双关：sleigh 免费，因为 it was on the house（既是“店家请客”也扣“屋顶”）
facts.quote: How much did Santa pay for his sleigh? Nothing, it was on the house.

facts.claim: 第二则把雪人有腹肌说成 abdominal snowman，以 abdominal 偷换 abominable 的谐音做字形梗
facts.quote: What do you call a snowman with a six pack? An abdominal snowman!

facts.claim: 作者收进一组“甲正经提问、乙把问题误听成陈述”的对话体笑话：问最好的圣诞树，答 I can（听成“你肯告诉我吗”）
facts.quote: ‘Can you tell me, in your view, what the best kind of Christmas tree is?’ ‘I can, a pine.’

facts.claim: 另一则对话体笑话拿地名做谐音：Caracas 被当成“圣诞大餐最爱哪道菜”的答案，包袱落在 Maracaibo 与 pigs in blankets
facts.quote: ‘When I was in Venezuela I enjoyed my favourite part of a Christmas dinner.’ ‘Caracas?’

facts.claim: 作者用德国圣诞果脯面包做 stollen 与 stolen 的同音梗，笑点在于对方把问句听成指控
facts.quote: A friend presented me with a traditional German Christmas fruity bread. I said, ‘Is this stollen?’ She said ‘No, I made it.’

facts.claim: 三博士笑话把东方三王的礼物逐条谐音化：gold guy（金）、frankincense fellow（乳香）、myrrh man（没药）
facts.quote: I recently met the three wise men. I said to the first one, ‘Wow, you’re dressed so ostentatiously, covered in precious metals!’

facts.claim: 圣诞倒数日历被换成满是小孔的碗状物，作者用 advent colander 与 advent calendar 的近音收尾
facts.quote: Instead of having doors to open every day in December, the thing I bought had hundreds of tiny holes

facts.claim: 静电毛衣一则把 free of charge 的“免费”义翻回“不带电”的字面义，属同一类习语义回literal化
facts.quote: I was given a Christmas jumper that was full of static electricity. I took it back and exchanged it for another one, free of charge.

relations.relation: 同音替换：把喜马拉雅雪人的固定称法 abominable 换成 abdominal（腹部的），让“有六块腹肌”成立
relations.quote: What do you call a snowman with a six pack? An abdominal snowman!

relations.relation: 德语面包名与英语 stolen（被偷）同音，问“这是 stollen 吗”被听成“这是偷来的吗”，故答 No, I made it
relations.quote: I said, ‘Is this stollen?’ She said ‘No, I made it.’

relations.relation: 日历 calendar 与滤盆 colander 近音，靠“每天开一扇门”与“满是孔洞”的物象错位坐实双关
relations.quote: I’d accidentally bought an advent colander.

relations.relation: 电荷 charge 与收费 charge 同词双义：换货“不收费”同时指新毛衣“不带电”，笑点靠义项回literal化
relations.quote: I took it back and exchanged it for another one, free of charge.

numbers.meaning: 雪人笑话的设定数字：six pack 既可指六块腹肌也可指六罐装，是 abdominal 双关的落点
numbers.quote: What do you call a snowman with a six pack?

numbers.meaning: 圣诞老人有三座花园，是为了把 hoe（锄地）重复成 ho-ho-ho 的圣诞老人笑声
numbers.quote: Why does Santa have three gardens? So he can hoe-hoe-hoe.

numbers.meaning: 三博士（three wise men）的人数，笑话按金、乳香、没药三样礼物分三段抖包袱
numbers.quote: I recently met the three wise men.

numbers.meaning: 倒数日历本是每天开一扇门，买错成滤盆后变成“几百个小孔”，数量差正是笑点
numbers.quote: the thing I bought had hundreds of tiny holes

numbers.meaning: 天气预报员答“两度”，问句问的是“多冷”与“凭什么资格”，两度既指气温也可指学位，故要对方 clarify
numbers.quote: He said, ‘Two degrees.’ I said, ‘I’m going to have to ask you to clarify.’
